newsitem.title: USA: Texas electricity prices ease with cooler weather.
newsitem.headline: Texas electricity prices ease with cooler weather.

text.p: Spot electricity prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) eased Monday with milder weather and forecasts of cooler temperatures, industry sources said.
Temperatures through much of Texas were in the mid-80 degree Fahrenheit area, with forecasts calling for a continuation of those levels or perhaps even cooler through to October 10.
On-peak ERCOT power for Tuesday delivery of a 16 hour block was talked in the $18.50-19.50 range from $19.60-20.60 for Monday delivery, the brokers and marketers said.
Off-peak next-day power was pegged steady in the $13.25-14.00 range, the sources said.
October on-peak ERCOT power was pegged lower near $17.50-18.50 from talk at $18.50-19.50 late last week, the sources said.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
